expected: With a fake driver, a failure at the cleanup cursor, SET TRACE OFF or the rollback leaves the traced statement's result intact and makes the next call open a new connection; a healthy cleanup keeps the connection. Offline evidence; the session state of a live server is shown only by the integration suite against a lab.
non_goals: no connection pool and no change to timeouts or the read-only rules
no claim that a live server's session was checked unless a live run is recorded
problem: explain_query turns tracing on, runs its statement and then turns tracing off and rolls back. A failure to open the cleanup cursor, run SET TRACE OFF or roll back is only logged, so the next tool call can reuse a session with tracing still on or a transaction still open. Retire the connection on the first failed cleanup step so the next call reconnects, keep a healthy connection after a healthy cleanup, and keep the statement's own result and errors as the client sees them. Do not put driver error text or SQL into anything the client receives.
title: Discard the shared connection when explain_query's trace cleanup fails
